title: Pan African University (PAU) Scholarship - African Union Commission
duration: Master's and PhD programmes at Pan African University institutes; the announcement does not state programme length
description: The Pan African University is an initiative of the Heads of State and Government of the African Union, a premier continental university network whose mission is to provide quality postgraduate education geared towards a prosperous, integrated and peaceful Africa. From 2014 to date PAU has issued 2549 certificates to 856 females and 1693 males from 50 member states, and the African Union Commission offers full scholarships to successful candidates.

title: Cusanuswerk Promotionsstipendium (Auswahlverfahren für Promovierende) — Cusanuswerk Doctoral Scholarship
program_type: Foundation scholarship for doctoral candidates (church talent development body)
duration: Maximum funding period three years and six months, with additional extension options in cases of illness, maternity protection periods and child-rearing.
description: The Cusanuswerk is the talent development body of the Catholic Church in Germany and funds doctoral candidates through its Promotionsförderung. The current round (Verfahren I-2027) accepts registrations until 1 November 2026 with a selection decision in March 2027. Funding is a parent-independent stipend of EUR 1,750 plus a EUR 100 research cost allowance, with optional health-insurance, child-care and family supplements and possible support for research stays abroad; the official page states no tuition-fee coverage. Foreign applicants must be admitted to a doctorate at a recognised university
